name: What factors determine the cost of professional bathroom painting?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of professional bathroom painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom painting costs generally depend on room size, ceiling height, surface repairs, and the amount of trim or detail work. A compact powder room costs significantly less than a large primary bathroom with complex architectural features, wainscoting, or multiple doors and windows. Other key cost drivers include whether the ceiling and cabinets are included, the extent of drywall patching needed from towel bars or moisture damage, and the quality of moisture-resistant paints chosen. Professional estimates account for the detailed masking required around tile, vanities, and fixtures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on bathroom square footage, surface repairs, masking around tile and fixtures, ceiling height, and whether cabinets or trim are included.
